Marcus Washington
Machine Learning Platform Engineer
Chicago, IL | marcus.w@example.test

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data and ML engineer with 5 years of experience deploying distributed data ingestion pipelines, production model serving clusters, and automated feature stores using Python, Apache Spark, and PostgreSQL.

EXPERIENCE
Apex Data Intelligence | ML Platform Engineer
2021 - Present
- Engineered distributed batch data extraction and transformation pipelines using Apache Spark and Python processing 4 Terabytes daily.
- Reduced model inference serving latency from 240ms to 38ms by optimizing ONNX runtime models and containerizing FastAPI workers.
- Managed automated workflow scheduling and DAG dependency graphs across 40 daily data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
- Supervised 3 data science interns on reproducible ML workflows and feature store design.

Kestrel Analytics | Data Engineer
2019 - 2021
- Designed and maintained relational PostgreSQL data warehouse schemas supporting complex ad-hoc analytical queries.
- Built real-time change-data-capture (CDC) pipelines streaming transaction events from MySQL into Snowflake with Debezium.
- Accelerated daily SQL aggregation reporting query runtimes by 55% using columnar indexing and partitioned materialized views.
- Wrote comprehensive data validation and drift detection test suites using Great Expectations.

SKILLS
Languages & Frameworks: Python, PySpark, FastAPI, SQL, Bash
Data & Pipelines: Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Redis
MLOps & Infrastructure: Docker, ONNX, MLflow, AWS S3, Great Expectations

EDUCATION
University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign
B.S. in Computer Science & Statistics (2015 - 2019)
